pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we explored the eerie discovery of two men dead on Vintem Hill wearing custom lead masks... but when police dug deeper into their backgrounds, the case turned into pure science fiction. Investigators uncovered a previous local incident where three other men were found dead under nearly identical circumstances, also wearing lead eye masks. The prevailing theory among their amateur radio club was that the men were experimenting with high-dose psychedelic drugs and homemade signal receivers, attempting to contact extraterrestrial intelligence or otherworldly dimensions during a solar eclipse. They allegedly believed the lead masks were necessary to protect their retinas from intense, blinding supernatural light. Official autopsy reports remained inconclusive, officially listing the cause of death as heart failure. But to this day, nobody knows what they saw.
